# v0.6 deterministic Human Druid level 20 (capstone) progression fixture.
# Completes the deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Druid chassis sweep to
# the PF1 level cap, preserving the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1 through level-16 fixtures, and the same canonical nature-bond
# selection (animal companion). Chosen input only: it names selections; it
# does not contain derived, computed, or parity values.
#
# Corpus grounding, read directly from the PCGen PF1 Core Rulebook data set
# rather than assumed to continue the pattern:
#   - Base attack bonus +15 (20 * 3 / 4 = 15), good Fortitude/Will +12
#     (20 / 2 + 2 = 12), poor Reflex +6 (20 / 3 = 6) -- all three from the
#     CLASS:Druid BONUS:COMBAT / BONUS:SAVE formulas on
#     data/pathfinder/paizo/roleplaying_game/core_rulebook/cr_classes.lst
#     line 93. Reflex STAYS +6 (an integer-division coincidence with levels
#     18 and 19), checked rather than assumed.
#   - Wild Empathy 21 (druid level 20 + Charisma modifier 1), from
#     cr_abilities_class.lst line 2864's BONUS:VAR|WildEmpathy|WildEmpathyLVL+CHA.
#   - Spells per day CAST:4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4,4 -- cr_classes.lst line 135.
#     All ten columns are 4; this is the only Druid row where every spell
#     level from orisons through 9th is a flat 4.
#   - The PF1 CRB Druid class table's level-20 "Special" column reads
#     "Wild shape (at will)" ONLY. The whole CATEGORY=Class|Druid.MOD feature
#     block (cr_abilities_class.lst lines 223-234) tops out at
#     PREVARGTEQ:Druid_CFP_Level,15 (Timeless Body) -- there is NO new named
#     Druid class feature at 16, 17, 18, 19, or 20, so Timeless Body (15) is
#     genuinely Druid's last named CRB class feature. The level-20 entry is
#     the terminal Wild Shape frequency step (progression index 9, which
#     cr_abilities_class.lst line 796's
#     DESC:You can change shape at will ... PREVARGTEQ:WildShapeProgression,9
#     renders as "at will"). Wild Shape stays deliberately named-but-unproven
#     here exactly as at levels 4/6/8/10/12/14/16/18 -- no shapeshifting
#     execution engine exists in this codebase to ground it against.
#   - Wild Shape's FORM capability does not improve past level 12: the
#     CATEGORY=Special Ability|Wild Shape.MOD WildShapeAbilityLevel grants
#     (cr_abilities_class.lst lines 857-861) stop at
#     PREVARGTEQ:DruidWildShape,12, so levels 16/18/20 are pure
#     frequency increments with no new form tier.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Druid burden surface: no animal
# companion stat block/advancement/link-share-spells, no Wild Shape
# execution (form list, duration tracking), no spellbook, no spells
# prepared, no spell slots, and no spell DCs.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-druid-level20
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:druid:20
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:12
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:druid_nature_bond:bond:animal_companion
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
